messages:
maya: Uploaded a slim PRD for 'Hybrid Ranking for Chat API' — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRD-2543. TL;DR: default server-side rerank using a dedicated reranker model, optional client-side pass-through mode for ultra-low-latency customers. Need decisions: MVP scope, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan. Ping @kevin @ranjit for perf tradeoffs. Thoughts?

kevin: Thanks — reading now. Main tradeoffs are latency vs cost vs determinism. Proposal: MVP = server-side rerank + deterministic score logs. Client-side mode as beta next sprint. Agree? :eyes: 

ranjit: Quick perf note — naive server-side rerank adds ~30-40ms p50 for 4k contexts, can be worse at high qps. Mitigations: continuous batching + prefix KV caching. Recommend default top_k=5 to limit compute. Also want to avoid KV cache thrash if reranker runs every turn.

sophia: Eval standpoint: we should track nDCG@5 and MRR. I’ll run evals on 3 customer prompt-sets: support, search, summarization. Candidate models: rerank-small-v2 (fast) and rerank-accurate-v1 (fallback).

eva: Customer note — Acme asked for deterministic ranks + per-request explainability (score breakdown). They also need audit logs for compliance. That affects API surface and docs.

maya: Updated PRD section 'Acceptance criteria' — pasted below. Please comment inline if anything missing.

```
Acceptance criteria:
- Server-side rerank enabled behind a feature flag
- Default top_k=5, configurable up to 50
- p50 increase <= 50ms for 95% of requests in US-EAST under typical load
- nDCG@5 improvement >= 8% vs baseline on internal eval sets
- Deterministic scoring when `deterministic=true` is set
- Audit log includes per-request rerank scores and model version
- SDKs expose `ranking.mode` param to opt into client-side flow
```

kevin: Those look good. Add rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with automatic fallback to baseline when p99 latency > 1s or error rate > 0.5%. Also add a stakeholder sign-off gate for enterprise customers.

ranjit: Implementation note: runtime will add rerank stage as an optional transform in the serving pipeline. We should support synchronous rerank with batching for MVP. Async patching (respond then patch results) is interesting but complex; drop for MVP. Also add quantization profile guidance for reranker weights.

maya: To keep scope tight, dropping async patching for MVP and moving it to backlog. Can someone draft a short smoke test checklist we can run during canary?

sophia: Smoke test checklist suggestion:
1) run 1k synthetic chats, measure p50/p95 and compare to baseline
2) validate score reproducibility with `deterministic=true` across 3 runs
3) verify nDCG uplift on a holdout eval set
4) verify audit log entries contain model version + raw scores

deploy-bot: ci/canary check: rerank-service unit tests passed, e2e smoke job failed on p95 latency (1.12s) for region eu-west-1 — assigned to @ranjit. Logs: `batch_wait=8ms batch_size=32` appears to spike under bursty load.

ranjit: Acknowledged. Likely batching knob needs tuning for eu-west throughput. Will investigate and optimize batch_wait/batch_size tradeoffs. ETA: EOD.

eva: Also adding docs item: SDK snippets for JS/Python showing `ranking.mode` and `deterministic` param, plus example response with `scores` array and `audit_log_id`. I can draft that after smoke passes.

maya: :thumbsup: Great. I’ll update the PRD with these edits, add the acceptance checklist, and link the canary run results. Please flag any objections before Friday sprint planning.
